quote_1: Randomized every timestamp, run id, and output filename we could find and reran the same 80 tasks.
quote_2: Each batch included a ⟦T2⟧ containing eight previously verified cases distributed without positional regularity.
justification: ⟦T1⟧ tests score sensitivity by rerunning the same tasks with randomized metadata, while ⟦T2⟧ inserts known-answer cases into batches and halts on erroneous judgments. These are distinct mechanisms with no specific common core beyond evaluation integrity.
